name: Lemon Blueberry Cottage Cheese Muffins
notes: Can do blackberry or raspberry instead of blueberry.

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.body: Heat oven to 400°F. Line 12 muffin cups with paper liners (or grease a tin).

steps.title: Whisk the dry ingredients
steps.body: In a large bowl, whisk together: **2 cups flour**, **½ cup sugar**, **2 tsp baking powder**, **½ tsp baking soda**, **½ tsp salt** and pinch ground nutmeg.

steps.title: Whisk the wet ingredients
steps.body: In a separate bowl or container, whisk or blend together: **2 eggs**, **1 cup cottage cheese**, **⅓ cup butter**, melted, **1 tsp lemon zest**, **3 Tbsp lemon juice** and **1 tsp vanilla**.

steps.title: Combine
steps.body: Combine mixtures until just moistened and fold in **1 cup blueberries** (fresh or fully frozen).

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Divide batter evenly among muffin cups, then bake 20–22 minutes, or until golden brown and tops spring back when lightly pressed.
